entries.title: Psalms 95:1
segments: Oh come, let us sing unto Jehovah; Let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 95:2
segments: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; Let us make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.

entries.title: Psalms 95:3
segments: For Jehovah is a great God, And a great King above all gods.

entries.title: Psalms 95:4
segments: In his hand are the deep places of the earth; The  heights of the mountains are his also.

entries.title: Psalms 95:5
segments: The sea is his, and he made it; And his hands formed the dry land.

entries.title: Psalms 95:6
segments: Oh come, let us worship and bow down; Let us kneel before Jehovah our Maker:

entries.title: Psalms 95:7
segments: For he is our God, And we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To-day,  oh that ye would hear his voice!

entries.title: Psalms 95:8
segments: Harden not your heart, as at  Meribah, As in the day of  Massah in the wilderness;

entries.title: Psalms 95:9
segments: When your fathers tempted me, Proved me, and saw my work.

entries.title: Psalms 95:10
segments: Forty years long was I grieved with [that] generation, And said, It is a people that do err in their heart, And they have not known my ways:

entries.title: Psalms 95:11
segments: Wherefore I sware in my wrath, That they should not enter into my rest.
